stem: A newly created data filter is in the Testing state. What happens to matching data?

options.text: It is still processed but labelled, so you can check it with the Test data filter name dimension
It is excluded from reports at once, and you can restore it later by setting the filter to Inactive
It is kept only in explorations and is deleted when the event data retention period ends
It is held back from standard reports but still sent to BigQuery Export, so you can check it there
